listing: Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity production MOBILE WEB selection screen for existing Korean USED PICK used PC marketplace, logical390x844 portrait, no phone frame, no OS bar. The user hates nested scrollbars, overlapping controls and stacked accordions. Render one complete full-height FILTER DIALOG, flat white#fff, Korean system sans, ink#182331, burnt orange#c94b26, hairline#e5e9ee. Top fixed header56px: small title '그래픽카드 필터' left, text '초기화' and simple X close right. Immediately beneath ONE horizontal underline tab bar with '칩 제조사' (selected orange underline), '제품군', '세대', 'VRAM'. Tabs are open text navigation, not boxed chips or pills. Under tabs a small12px single-line chosen context 'NVIDIA · RTX 40' optional with subtle divider. Main area ONE clean selection list: '전체', 'NVIDIA', 'AMD', 'Intel', each52px high, label left, native square checkbox right, NVIDIA checked orange, other unchecked; zero cards, no inside-scroll borders, no duplicate group headings, no accordion +/- arrows, no counts per option. Entire available list area is the ONLY vertical scroll region; top header/tabs and bottom action stay fixed. Bottom safe-area footer with one full-width48px orange button '매물 보기',12px gutters; no fake results-count. Large unused space is white rather than invented text. Existing marketplace behind panel is not visible, this is fullscreen on mobile. Font labels14px, header18px, controls44px minhit. No developer notes, prose, gradients, shadows, mascots or decorative widgets. The code will reuse actual existing facet filter state/options and data; screenshot only communicates design. Coherent practical compact mobile selection UX.
picker: Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity production MOBILE WEB model selector for existing Korean USED PICK price analysis and computer-builder, logical390x844 portrait, no phone frame/noOSbar. Fullscreen native DIALOG white#fff, ink#182331, orange#c94b26, light#e5e9ee dividers, Korean system sans. Fixed56px header '모델 선택' left, '초기화' and X close right. First top horizontal category underline strip '전체', 'CPU', '그래픽카드', 'RAM', '메인보드', 'SSD' with 그래픽카드 orange underline, may horizontally scroll to HDD/파워. Below slim44px search field '모델명 검색' with small search icon,12pxsidegutters. Then SECOND compact text filter-type underline tab strip '모델' (selected orange), '칩 제조사', '시리즈', 'VRAM'. This changes the sole content pane to a model list OR simple radio options; do not stack dropdown menus or accordions. A concise small12px applied-context line 'NVIDIA · RTX 40' with no pills. ONE scroll region: plain model list rows64px, left actual readable model names RTX 4060 / RTX 4060 Ti / RTX 4070 / RTX 4070 SUPER / RTX 4070 Ti / RTX 4080 / RTX 4090, optional concise price right before radio; RTX 4070 selected native orange check circle at right, other empty circles. Use only illustrative prices for first3 rows e.g '350,000원','420,000원','740,000원'; no fabricated extra market data. Thin horizontal dividers only, no cards, no double-scroll areas. Model row or check is tappable; single selection immediately opens chart or chooses part, no extra big confirmation button. Fixed compact footer with '이전', '1 / 3', '다음'44px paging actions; no huge bottom sheet radius or background page. Models and facet options share same region; this same pattern applies to price search and PC parts selection. No redundant captions, marketing copy, sample-count clutter, gradients, heavy shadows, icons beyond search/close/check. Layout is implementable using HTML/CSS and existing real data/filter logic.
